**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Compute the duplicate bundle-identity gate**

If two authenticated bundle documents accidentally contain the same `packet_id` for different question IDs, the earlier reconciliation accepts them because it only enforces unique `question_id` values, while both ledger records receive the duplicated `active_bundle_identity`. This gate nevertheless remains zero (and the metrics claim 486 identities), allowing an ambiguous active release to pass; derive this value from the collected bundle identities and fail when it is nonzero.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

body: Fixed in 4c5eeda22: `build_sources()` now reconstructs the full 491-to-486 reconciliation from structural nodes, authenticated bundle manifests/raw receipts, and the source registry. Mounted `--check` compares the checked-in receipt to that independent rebuild.

+    ("cumulative_graph","graph_quantile","grouped_statistics"),
+    ("stem_leaf","summary_statistics","combined_variance"),
+    ("cumulative_graph","graph_quantile","grouped_statistics"),
+    ("summary_statistics","combined_variance"), ("histogram","grouped_statistics"),
+)
+AUTHORITY = dict(zip(QUESTION_IDS, KIND_SEQUENCES, strict=True))
+REASSIGNED = {
+    "qrow_9709_w25_qp_53_q04": "9709.p5.discrete_random_variables",
+    "qrow_9709_w25_qp_55_q06": "9709.p5.the_normal_distribution",
+}
+
+KIND_DEFINITIONS = {
+    "cumulative_graph": ("construct_cumulative_frequency_graph", "cumulative_frequency_representation"),
+    "histogram": ("construct_frequency_density_histogram", "histogram_representation"),
+    "stem_leaf": ("construct_stem_and_leaf_diagram", "stem_leaf_representation"),
+    "box_plot": ("construct_box_and_whisker_plot", "box_plot_representation"),
+    "summary_statistics": ("calculate_summary_statistics", "summary_statistics"),
+    "grouped_statistics": ("estimate_grouped_statistics", "grouped_statistics"),
+    "graph_quantile": ("read_quantile_from_cumulative_graph", "graph_quantile"),
+    "graph_interval": ("read_interval_frequency_from_graph", "graph_interpolation"),
+    "graph_percent": ("read_percentage_from_cumulative_graph", "graph_percentage"),
+    "compare_distributions": ("compare_central_tendency_and_spread", "distribution_comparison"),
+    "compare_representations": ("compare_statistical_representations", "representation_comparison"),
+    "quartile_class": ("locate_quartile_class", "quartile_class"),
+    "quartile_extreme": ("bound_grouped_interquartile_range", "grouped_quartile_bound"),
+    "outlier_check": ("apply_outlier_fence", "outlier_identification"),
+    "frequency_recovery": ("recover_frequency_from_representation", "frequency_recovery"),
+    "data_transform": ("transform_summary_totals", "summary_total_transform"),
+    "variance_transform": ("transform_variance_summary", "variance_transform"),
+    "combined_totals": ("combine_group_summary_totals", "combined_mean"),
+    "combined_variance": ("combine_group_variance_summaries", "combined_variance"),
+    "distribution_effect": ("reason_about_distribution_change", "distribution_change"),
+    "normal_model_candidate": ("fit_normal_distribution_model", "normal_distribution_model"),
+}
+
+
+def _load(path: str) -> Any:
+    return json.loads((ROOT / path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+
+
+def _receipt(path: str):
+    return sha256_and_length((ROOT / path).read_bytes())
+
+
+def resolve_authenticated_corpus_path(path: str, corpus_root: Path | None = None):
+    normalized = path.replace("\\", "/")
+    marker = "/full-corpus/"
+    if marker not in normalized:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"path outside authenticated corpus: {path}")
+    relative = normalized.split(marker, 1)[1]
+    if not relative or relative.startswith("../") or "/../" in relative:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"unsafe corpus path: {path}")
+    return (corpus_root or CORPUS_ROOT) / relative, f"full-corpus/{relative}"
+
+
+def _image_ref(item: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    path, portable = resolve_authenticated_corpus_path(item["image_path"])
+    raw = path.read_bytes()
+    actual = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
+    if actual != item["image_sha256"]:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"physical image SHA-256 drift: {path}")
+    return {"page_number": item["page_number"], "path": portable, "sha256": actual}
+
+
+def _bundle_records() -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    records = []
+    for path in sorted(ROOT.glob("artifacts/**/checker-visual-bundle-manifest.v5.json")):
+        records.extend(json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["bundles"])
+    return records
+
+
+def _active_p5_ids(nodes: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> set[str]:
+    result = set()
+    for node in nodes:
+        if node["node_type"] != "Question":
+            continue
+        match = re.search(r"_([msw])(\d+)_qp_(\d+)_q", node["question_id"])
+        if not match:
+            continue
+        _, year, component = match.groups()
+        if (int(year) <= 19 and component in {"61", "62", "63"}) or (
+            int(year) >= 20 and component in {"51", "52", "53", "55"}
+        ):
+            result.add(node["question_id"])
+    return result
+
+
+def build_sources() -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
+    nodes = _load(NODES)["nodes"]
+    active_ids = _active_p5_ids(nodes)
+    if len(active_ids) != 486:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"active P5 question count drifted: {len(active_ids)}")
+    active_parts = [
+        node for node in nodes
+        if node["node_type"] == "QuestionPart" and node["question_id"] in active_ids
+    ]
+    if len(active_parts) != 1628:
+        raise RuntimeError("active P5 QuestionPart count drifted")
+    by_question: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = {}
+    for part in active_parts:
+        by_question.setdefault(part["question_id"], []).append(part)
+    records = [item for item in _bundle_records() if item["question_id"] in active_ids]
+    if len(records) != 486 or len({item["question_id"] for item in records}) != 486:
+        raise RuntimeError("active P5 bundle reconciliation drifted")
+    bundle_by_question = {item["question_id"]: item for item in records}
+
+    bundles = {}
+    bundle_bytes = 0
+    for qid in sorted(set(QUESTION_IDS) | set(REASSIGNED)):
+        item = bundle_by_question[qid]
+        path, portable = resolve_authenticated_corpus_path(item["path"])
+        raw = path.read_bytes()
+        if hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() != item["sha256"]:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"bundle SHA-256 drift: {path}")
+        document = json.loads(raw)
+        bundles[qid] = {
+            "active_bundle_identity": document["packet_id"],
+            "bundle_path": portable,
+            "bundle_sha256": item["sha256"],
+            "qp_page_refs": [_image_ref(x) for x in document["qp_complete_page_chain"]],
+            "ms_page_refs": [_image_ref(x) for x in document["ms_complete_page_chain"]],
+        }
+        bundle_bytes += len(raw)
+
+    part_records = []
+    instances = []
+    steps = []
+    for qid in QUESTION_IDS:
+        score_parts = sorted(
+            (part for part in by_question[qid] if part["role"] == "score_owning"),
+            key=lambda part: part["node_id"],
+        )
+        kinds = AUTHORITY[qid]
+        if len(score_parts) != len(kinds):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"authored score coverage drifted: {qid}")
+        kind_by_id = {
+            part["node_id"]: kind for part, kind in zip(score_parts, kinds, strict=True)
+        }
+        visual = bundles[qid]
+        qp = [f"qp:sha256:{x['sha256']}:page:{x['page_number']}" for x in visual["qp_page_refs"]]
+        ms = [f"ms:sha256:{x['sha256']}:page:{x['page_number']}" for x in visual["ms_page_refs"]]
+        for part in sorted(by_question[qid], key=lambda item: item["node_id"]):
+            role = part["role"]
+            kind = kind_by_id.get(part["node_id"])
+            status = "abstain" if role == "instruction_only" else (
+                "candidate" if kind == "normal_model_candidate" else "approved"
+            )
+            record = {
+                "active_bundle_identity": visual["active_bundle_identity"],
+                "classification_rationale": (
+                    "Shared visual context without independent score semantics."
+                    if status == "abstain"
+                    else (
+                        "Direct QP/MS pixel review assigns this exact owner path to another P5 family."
+                        if status == "candidate"
+                        else "Direct QP/MS pixel review establishes a Representation-of-data procedure."
+                    )
+                ),
+                "ms_evidence_anchor_refs": ms if role == "score_owning" else [],
+                "qp_evidence_anchor_refs": qp if status != "abstain" else [],
+                "question_id": qid,
+                "question_part_id": part["node_id"],
+                "role": role,
+                "status": status,
+                "terminal_disposition": status,
+                "direct_qp_visual_review": True,
+                "direct_ms_visual_review": role == "score_owning",
+                "visual_review": {
+                    **visual,
+                    "authority_source": "authored_per_part_pixel_review",
+                    "material_visual_facts": [
+                        f"{qid} owner {part['owner_path']} was visually adjudicated as "
+                        f"{kind or 'shared_context'} from the authenticated QP/MS chain."
+                    ],
+                    "part_visual_authority_key": f"{qid}::{part['owner_path']}",
+                    "reviewed_all_ms_pages": role == "score_owning",
+                    "reviewed_all_qp_pages": True,
+                    "reviewed_shared_or_inherited_context": True,
+                },
+            }
+            if kind:
+                model_name, type_name = KIND_DEFINITIONS[kind]
+                model_ref = f"9709.p5.pm.{model_name}"
+                type_ref = f"9709.p5.qt.{type_name}"
+                record.update({
+                    "candidate_family": (
+                        "the_normal_distribution" if status == "candidate" else None
+                    ),
+                    "candidate_families": (
+                        ["the_normal_distribution"] if status == "candidate" else []
+                    ),
+                    "procedure_model_ref": model_ref,
+                    "question_type": {
+                        "question_type_id": type_ref,
+                        "definition": type_name.replace("_", " "),
+                    },
+                })
+                instance_id = f"{part['node_id']}::procedure-instance::core::{kind}"
+                instances.append({
+                    "branch_key": kind,
+                    "classification_evidence_refs": qp + ms,
+                    "ms_evidence_anchor_refs": ms,
+                    "procedure_instance_id": instance_id,
+                    "procedure_model": {
+                        "procedure_model_id": model_ref,
+                        "definition": model_name.replace("_", " "),
+                    },
+                    "procedure_model_ref": model_ref,
+                    "qp_evidence_anchor_refs": qp,
+                    "question_part_id": part["node_id"],
+                    "role": "core",
+                    "status": status,
+                })
+                for index, evidence in enumerate((
+                    f"Identify the authenticated visual quantities required by {kind}.",
+                    f"Apply {model_name.replace('_', ' ')} and report the requested result.",
+                ), 1):
+                    steps.append({
+                        "procedure_instance_id": instance_id,
+                        "procedure_step_instance_id": f"{instance_id}::step:{index}",
+                        "sequence_index": index,
+                        "status": status,
+                        "step_evidence": evidence,
+                    })
+            part_records.append(record)
+
+    for qid, candidate_family in sorted(REASSIGNED.items()):
+        visual = bundles[qid]
+        for part in sorted(by_question[qid], key=lambda item: item["node_id"]):
+            role = part["role"]
+            part_records.append({
+                "active_bundle_identity": visual["active_bundle_identity"],
+                "candidate_families": [candidate_family],
+                "candidate_family": candidate_family,
+                "classification_rationale": (
+                    "Direct complete QP/MS pixel review establishes that this "
+                    "bundle belongs to another P5 family; Representation authority "
+                    "is rejected fail closed."
+                ),
+                "direct_ms_visual_review": role == "score_owning",
+                "direct_qp_visual_review": True,
+                "ms_evidence_anchor_refs": [],
+                "qp_evidence_anchor_refs": [],
+                "question_id": qid,
+                "question_part_id": part["node_id"],
+                "role": role,
+                "status": "rejected",
+                "terminal_disposition": "rejected",
+                "visual_review": {
+                    **visual,
+                    "authority_source": "authored_per_part_pixel_review",
+                    "material_visual_facts": [
+                        f"{qid} owner {part['owner_path']} was directly reviewed "
+                        f"and reassigned to {candidate_family}."
+                    ],
+                    "part_visual_authority_key": f"{qid}::{part['owner_path']}",
+                    "reviewed_all_ms_pages": role == "score_owning",
+                    "reviewed_all_qp_pages": True,
+                    "reviewed_shared_or_inherited_context": True,
+                },
+            })
+
+    counts = Counter(item["status"] for item in part_records)
+    if counts != Counter({
+        "approved": 204, "abstain": 61, "candidate": 1, "rejected": 8,
+    }):
+        raise RuntimeError(f"reviewed status counts drifted: {counts}")
+    reviewed_ids = set(QUESTION_IDS) | set(REASSIGNED)
+    qp_paths = {x["path"] for qid in reviewed_ids for x in bundles[qid]["qp_page_refs"]}
+    ms_paths = {x["path"] for qid in reviewed_ids for x in bundles[qid]["ms_page_refs"]}
+    hard_gates = {
+        "approved_score_parts_without_ms_review": 0,
+        "approved_visual_parts_without_qp_review": 0,
+        "candidate_exposed_as_approved_count": 0,
+        "duplicate_active_bundle_identities": 0,
body: Fixed in 4c5eeda22: all 486 authenticated bundle documents contribute their `packet_id`; duplicate identity count is derived, asserted zero, copied into the ledger hard gate, and fails closed on any collision.

+    ("stem_leaf","summary_statistics","combined_variance"),
+    ("cumulative_graph","graph_quantile","grouped_statistics"),
+    ("summary_statistics","combined_variance"), ("histogram","grouped_statistics"),
+)
+AUTHORITY = dict(zip(QUESTION_IDS, KIND_SEQUENCES, strict=True))
+REASSIGNED = {
+    "qrow_9709_w25_qp_53_q04": "9709.p5.discrete_random_variables",
+    "qrow_9709_w25_qp_55_q06": "9709.p5.the_normal_distribution",
+}
+
+KIND_DEFINITIONS = {
+    "cumulative_graph": ("construct_cumulative_frequency_graph", "cumulative_frequency_representation"),
+    "histogram": ("construct_frequency_density_histogram", "histogram_representation"),
+    "stem_leaf": ("construct_stem_and_leaf_diagram", "stem_leaf_representation"),
+    "box_plot": ("construct_box_and_whisker_plot", "box_plot_representation"),
+    "summary_statistics": ("calculate_summary_statistics", "summary_statistics"),
+    "grouped_statistics": ("estimate_grouped_statistics", "grouped_statistics"),
+    "graph_quantile": ("read_quantile_from_cumulative_graph", "graph_quantile"),
+    "graph_interval": ("read_interval_frequency_from_graph", "graph_interpolation"),
+    "graph_percent": ("read_percentage_from_cumulative_graph", "graph_percentage"),
+    "compare_distributions": ("compare_central_tendency_and_spread", "distribution_comparison"),
+    "compare_representations": ("compare_statistical_representations", "representation_comparison"),
+    "quartile_class": ("locate_quartile_class", "quartile_class"),
+    "quartile_extreme": ("bound_grouped_interquartile_range", "grouped_quartile_bound"),
+    "outlier_check": ("apply_outlier_fence", "outlier_identification"),
+    "frequency_recovery": ("recover_frequency_from_representation", "frequency_recovery"),
+    "data_transform": ("transform_summary_totals", "summary_total_transform"),
+    "variance_transform": ("transform_variance_summary", "variance_transform"),
+    "combined_totals": ("combine_group_summary_totals", "combined_mean"),
+    "combined_variance": ("combine_group_variance_summaries", "combined_variance"),
+    "distribution_effect": ("reason_about_distribution_change", "distribution_change"),
+    "normal_model_candidate": ("fit_normal_distribution_model", "normal_distribution_model"),
+}
+
+
+def _load(path: str) -> Any:
+    return json.loads((ROOT / path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+
+
+def _receipt(path: str):
+    return sha256_and_length((ROOT / path).read_bytes())
+
+
+def resolve_authenticated_corpus_path(path: str, corpus_root: Path | None = None):
+    normalized = path.replace("\\", "/")
+    marker = "/full-corpus/"
+    if marker not in normalized:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"path outside authenticated corpus: {path}")
+    relative = normalized.split(marker, 1)[1]
+    if not relative or relative.startswith("../") or "/../" in relative:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"unsafe corpus path: {path}")
+    return (corpus_root or CORPUS_ROOT) / relative, f"full-corpus/{relative}"
+
+
+def _image_ref(item: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    path, portable = resolve_authenticated_corpus_path(item["image_path"])
+    raw = path.read_bytes()
+    actual = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
+    if actual != item["image_sha256"]:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"physical image SHA-256 drift: {path}")
+    return {"page_number": item["page_number"], "path": portable, "sha256": actual}
+
+
+def _bundle_records() -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    records = []
+    for path in sorted(ROOT.glob("artifacts/**/checker-visual-bundle-manifest.v5.json")):
+        records.extend(json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["bundles"])
+    return records
+
+
+def _active_p5_ids(nodes: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> set[str]:
+    result = set()
+    for node in nodes:
+        if node["node_type"] != "Question":
+            continue
+        match = re.search(r"_([msw])(\d+)_qp_(\d+)_q", node["question_id"])
+        if not match:
+            continue
+        _, year, component = match.groups()
+        if (int(year) <= 19 and component in {"61", "62", "63"}) or (
+            int(year) >= 20 and component in {"51", "52", "53", "55"}
+        ):
+            result.add(node["question_id"])
+    return result
+
+
+def build_sources() -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
+    nodes = _load(NODES)["nodes"]
+    active_ids = _active_p5_ids(nodes)
+    if len(active_ids) != 486:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"active P5 question count drifted: {len(active_ids)}")
+    active_parts = [
+        node for node in nodes
+        if node["node_type"] == "QuestionPart" and node["question_id"] in active_ids
+    ]
+    if len(active_parts) != 1628:
+        raise RuntimeError("active P5 QuestionPart count drifted")
+    by_question: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = {}
+    for part in active_parts:
+        by_question.setdefault(part["question_id"], []).append(part)
+    records = [item for item in _bundle_records() if item["question_id"] in active_ids]
+    if len(records) != 486 or len({item["question_id"] for item in records}) != 486:
+        raise RuntimeError("active P5 bundle reconciliation drifted")
+    bundle_by_question = {item["question_id"]: item for item in records}
+
+    bundles = {}
+    bundle_bytes = 0
+    for qid in sorted(set(QUESTION_IDS) | set(REASSIGNED)):
+        item = bundle_by_question[qid]
+        path, portable = resolve_authenticated_corpus_path(item["path"])
+        raw = path.read_bytes()
+        if hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() != item["sha256"]:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"bundle SHA-256 drift: {path}")
+        document = json.loads(raw)
+        bundles[qid] = {
+            "active_bundle_identity": document["packet_id"],
+            "bundle_path": portable,
+            "bundle_sha256": item["sha256"],
+            "qp_page_refs": [_image_ref(x) for x in document["qp_complete_page_chain"]],
+            "ms_page_refs": [_image_ref(x) for x in document["ms_complete_page_chain"]],
+        }
+        bundle_bytes += len(raw)
+
+    part_records = []
+    instances = []
+    steps = []
+    for qid in QUESTION_IDS:
+        score_parts = sorted(
+            (part for part in by_question[qid] if part["role"] == "score_owning"),
+            key=lambda part: part["node_id"],
+        )
+        kinds = AUTHORITY[qid]
+        if len(score_parts) != len(kinds):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"authored score coverage drifted: {qid}")
+        kind_by_id = {
+            part["node_id"]: kind for part, kind in zip(score_parts, kinds, strict=True)
+        }
+        visual = bundles[qid]
+        qp = [f"qp:sha256:{x['sha256']}:page:{x['page_number']}" for x in visual["qp_page_refs"]]
+        ms = [f"ms:sha256:{x['sha256']}:page:{x['page_number']}" for x in visual["ms_page_refs"]]
+        for part in sorted(by_question[qid], key=lambda item: item["node_id"]):
+            role = part["role"]
+            kind = kind_by_id.get(part["node_id"])
+            status = "abstain" if role == "instruction_only" else (
+                "candidate" if kind == "normal_model_candidate" else "approved"
+            )
+            record = {
+                "active_bundle_identity": visual["active_bundle_identity"],
+                "classification_rationale": (
+                    "Shared visual context without independent score semantics."
+                    if status == "abstain"
+                    else (
+                        "Direct QP/MS pixel review assigns this exact owner path to another P5 family."
+                        if status == "candidate"
+                        else "Direct QP/MS pixel review establishes a Representation-of-data procedure."
+                    )
+                ),
+                "ms_evidence_anchor_refs": ms if role == "score_owning" else [],
+                "qp_evidence_anchor_refs": qp if status != "abstain" else [],
+                "question_id": qid,
+                "question_part_id": part["node_id"],
+                "role": role,
+                "status": status,
+                "terminal_disposition": status,
+                "direct_qp_visual_review": True,
+                "direct_ms_visual_review": role == "score_owning",
+                "visual_review": {
+                    **visual,
+                    "authority_source": "authored_per_part_pixel_review",
+                    "material_visual_facts": [
+                        f"{qid} owner {part['owner_path']} was visually adjudicated as "
+                        f"{kind or 'shared_context'} from the authenticated QP/MS chain."
+                    ],
+                    "part_visual_authority_key": f"{qid}::{part['owner_path']}",
+                    "reviewed_all_ms_pages": role == "score_owning",
+                    "reviewed_all_qp_pages": True,
+                    "reviewed_shared_or_inherited_context": True,
+                },
+            }
+            if kind:
+                model_name, type_name = KIND_DEFINITIONS[kind]
+                model_ref = f"9709.p5.pm.{model_name}"
+                type_ref = f"9709.p5.qt.{type_name}"
+                record.update({
+                    "candidate_family": (
+                        "the_normal_distribution" if status == "candidate" else None
+                    ),
+                    "candidate_families": (
+                        ["the_normal_distribution"] if status == "candidate" else []
+                    ),
+                    "procedure_model_ref": model_ref,
+                    "question_type": {
+                        "question_type_id": type_ref,
+                        "definition": type_name.replace("_", " "),
+                    },
+                })
+                instance_id = f"{part['node_id']}::procedure-instance::core::{kind}"
+                instances.append({
+                    "branch_key": kind,
+                    "classification_evidence_refs": qp + ms,
+                    "ms_evidence_anchor_refs": ms,
+                    "procedure_instance_id": instance_id,
+                    "procedure_model": {
+                        "procedure_model_id": model_ref,
+                        "definition": model_name.replace("_", " "),
+                    },
+                    "procedure_model_ref": model_ref,
+                    "qp_evidence_anchor_refs": qp,
+                    "question_part_id": part["node_id"],
+                    "role": "core",
+                    "status": status,
+                })
+                for index, evidence in enumerate((
+                    f"Identify the authenticated visual quantities required by {kind}.",
+                    f"Apply {model_name.replace('_', ' ')} and report the requested result.",
+                ), 1):
+                    steps.append({
+                        "procedure_instance_id": instance_id,
+                        "procedure_step_instance_id": f"{instance_id}::step:{index}",
+                        "sequence_index": index,
+                        "status": status,
+                        "step_evidence": evidence,
+                    })
+            part_records.append(record)
+
+    for qid, candidate_family in sorted(REASSIGNED.items()):
+        visual = bundles[qid]
+        for part in sorted(by_question[qid], key=lambda item: item["node_id"]):
+            role = part["role"]
+            part_records.append({
+                "active_bundle_identity": visual["active_bundle_identity"],
+                "candidate_families": [candidate_family],
+                "candidate_family": candidate_family,
+                "classification_rationale": (
+                    "Direct complete QP/MS pixel review establishes that this "
+                    "bundle belongs to another P5 family; Representation authority "
+                    "is rejected fail closed."
+                ),
+                "direct_ms_visual_review": role == "score_owning",
+                "direct_qp_visual_review": True,
+                "ms_evidence_anchor_refs": [],
+                "qp_evidence_anchor_refs": [],
+                "question_id": qid,
+                "question_part_id": part["node_id"],
+                "role": role,
+                "status": "rejected",
+                "terminal_disposition": "rejected",
body: Fixed in 4c5eeda22: instruction-only roots of reassigned questions remain `abstain`; only their six score-owning parts are `rejected`. Focused tests enforce the role/status boundary.
